title: R1. One-form route obligation
milestone_description: There is a real c>0 such that, for every sufficiently large natural n, there exist integers b,a with 0 < |b+a Re(riemannZeta(9))| < exp(-c n). The published statement places no bound on b or a and does not require them to come from the coefficient-map or weighted-lattice construction. The index n labels only the error threshold. Producing these forms with the actual construction and its denominator, height and nonvanishing controls is a separate concrete obligation; this unrestricted existence statement is not claimed to be strictly stronger than irrationality.
